about: The Cathedral of the Bone Choir (pack bonechoir): a cathedral the dead raised inside the skeleton of something vast. Pale ruin stone (ivory and ash grey) for walls and floors, bone as architecture (ribcage vaults, bundled long-bone pillars, skull keystones), Gothic pointed doorways, choir stalls of white singers, bells; warm candle gold the only light. Rooms on a 4 m grid, 7 m a storey, 14 m one-storey rooms, doorways 4 x 7 m (tools/dungeons/authoring/themes/ossuary.py).
